use_cases: Primary call-to-action buttons in forms and landing pages
Navigation triggers with multiple visual variants
Icon-only buttons for compact UI toolbar actions
Destructive action buttons for delete/remove operations
ai_summary: A versatile, accessible button component built with Radix UI Slot and class variance authority, supporting multiple visual variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and sizes. Features standard shadow styling with hover states and disabled functionality, suitable for any SaaS or web application requiring form inputs or navigation controls.
